alternatives.name: APPEND_ONLY_LEDGER_WITH_PIT_AND_AMENDMENT_ORDERING
tradeoffs: Append-only ledger is simpler than a relational store but requires explicit dedup and amendment ordering rules.

negative: Delayed SEC filings remain delayed in replay; no live-tape claims are permitted.
positive: regulatory_disclosure family can surface entitled fixture data without weakening other whale families.

decision.summary: Whale disclosure events are stored in an append-only JSONL ledger keyed by accession_number and source_revision_id. Amendment filings sort after base filings. PIT queries exclude events whose available_time exceeds prediction_cutoff. All events retain disclosure_lag_note and research_only defaults.
decision.title: Whale ledger ingestion semantics and PIT eligibility

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance authorizes fixture-first EDGAR ingestion for regulatory_disclosure only. Other whale families remain blocked until separately entitled.
